license_required.quote: No person shall enter upon the practice of architecture or hold forth as an architect or registered architect, unless the person has complied with sections 4703.01 to 4703.19 of the Revised Code and is the holder of a certificate of qualification to practice architecture issued or renewed and registered under those sections.

issuing_authority.quote: Any person shall, before engaging in the practice of architecture or before being styled or known as an architect, secure from the architects board a certificate of the person's qualifications to practice under the title of "architect," and be registered with the board.

name.quote: The governor shall appoint an architects board, which shall be composed of five individuals, four of whom shall be architects who have been in active practice in the state for not less than five years previous to their appointment, and one of whom shall be a member of the general public and who is not an architect.

available.quote: The architects board shall adopt rules to certify and register an applicant for a certificate of qualification to practice architecture who is licensed or registered as an architect in another country, holds a current certificate in good standing issued by the national council of architectural registration boards, and wishes to be registered in this state.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed or registered as an architect in another country and hold a current NCARB certificate in good standing; or hold a certification, registration, or license to practice architecture in another state (under Chapter 4796).
requirements.quote: The board shall certify and register an applicant in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code for a certificate of qualification to practice architecture if either of the following applies: (A) The applicant holds a certification, registration, or license to practice architecture in another state.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall enter upon the practice of architecture or hold forth as an architect or registered architect, unless the person has complied with sections 4703.01 to 4703.19 of the Revised Code and is the holder of a certificate of qualification to practice architecture issued or renewed and registered under those sections.

title_protection.quote: No other person shall assume such title or use any abbreviation, or any words, letters, or figures, to indicate or imply that the person is an architect or registered architect

scope_protection.quote: No person shall enter upon the practice of architecture or hold forth as an architect or registered architect, unless the person has complied with sections 4703.01 to 4703.19 of the Revised Code and is the holder of a certificate of qualification to practice architecture issued or renewed and registered under those sections.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: In case it is shown that the certificate was obtained by fraud;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder has been found guilty of fraud or deceit in professional practice, or has been convicted of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In case the holder of the certificate has been found guilty by the board or by a court of justice of any fraud or deceit in the holder's professional practice, or has been convicted of a felony by a court of justice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder has been found guilty of gross negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in performing services as an architect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In case the holder has been found guilty by the board of gross negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the performance of the holder's services as an architect or in the practice of architecture;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder signed plans as registered architect for a building where the holder was not the actual architect without prior written consent of the originating architect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In case the holder of the certificate has been found guilty by the board of signing plans for the construction of a building as a "registered architect" where the holder is not the actual architect of such building and where the holder is without prior written consent of the architect originating the design or other documents used in the plans;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder has been found guilty of aiding and abetting persons not properly registered in activities constituting the practice of architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In case the holder of the certificate has been found guilty by the board of aiding and abetting another person or persons not properly registered as required by sections 4703.01 to 4703.19 of the Revised Code, in the performance of activities that in any manner or extent constitute the practice of architecture.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of rules governing standards of service, conduct, and practice in architecture.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: who violates any rule governing the standards of service, conduct, and practice adopted pursuant to section 4703.02 of the Revised Code

insurance_required.quote: The board shall include among the rules adopted governing the standards of practice, requirements regarding financial responsibility and professional liability insurance.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No corporation organized under Chapter 1701. of the Revised Code shall engage in providing architectural services in this state without obtaining a certificate of authorization from the architects board.

design_build_authorized.quote: The architectural services are offered by the person who intends to perform the actual construction of an improvement to real property as part of a design-build contract.

permitted_firm_structures.quote: A firm, partnership, association, limited liability company, or corporation may provide architectural services in this state as long as the services are provided only through natural persons registered to provide those services in this state

firm_design_professional_ownership_minim.quote: No firm, partnership, association, limited liability company, or corporation shall provide or offer to provide architectural services in this state unless more than fifty per cent of the partners, members, or shareholders, more than fifty per cent of the directors in the case of a corporation or professional association, more than fifty per cent of the managers in the case of a limited liability company the management of which is not reserved to its members, and more than fifty per cent of the trustees in the case of an employee stock ownership plan, are professional engineers, surveyors, architects, or landscape architects or a combination of those professions, who are registered in this or any other state and who own more than fifty per cent of the interests in the firm

seal_required.quote: Every holder of such certificate or its renewal shall secure a seal of the design prescribed by the rules of the architects board. All working drawings and specifications prepared by or under the supervision of the holder shall be imprinted with this seal.

value: residential buildings as defined by section 3781.06 of the Revised Code
industrialized one-, two-, or three-family units or structures within the meaning of 'industrialized unit' as provided in section 3781.06 of the Revised Code
buildings where building official determines no plans or specifications are required for approval (replacement equipment or systems, improvements, alterations, repairs, painting, decorating)
exempt_building_types.quote: Sections 4703.01 to 4703.19 of the Revised Code do not prevent persons other than architects from preparing plans, drawings, specifications, or data, filing applications for building permits, or obtaining those permits for residential buildings, as defined by section 3781.06 of the Revised Code, or buildings erected as industrialized one-, two-, or three-family units or structures within the meaning of the term "industrialized unit" as provided in section 3781.06 of the Revised Code.

ncarb_certificate_reciprocity_prima_faci.quote: The architects board shall adopt rules to certify and register an applicant for a certificate of qualification to practice architecture who is licensed or registered as an architect in another country, holds a current certificate in good standing issued by the national council of architectural registration boards, and wishes to be registered in this state.

ncarb_standards_adoptable.quote: If the board adopts rules pertaining to continuing education requirements, the board shall, in general, follow model continuing education recommendations established by the national council of architectural registration boards or a similar successor organization.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: Whoever violates division (A) of section 4703.18 or section 4703.411 of the Revised Code is guilty of a misdemeanor of the third degree;

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.quote: for each subsequent offense such person is guilty of a misdemeanor of the first degree.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: The fine imposed shall be not more than one thousand dollars for each offense but shall not exceed five thousand dollars regardless of the number of offenses the certificate holder has committed between the time the fine is imposed and the time any previous fine was imposed.
